title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
我常常从那场噩梦里惊醒，睁眼时却发现，那不是噩梦，是曾经发生过的事实。残酷到，足够毁掉我一生的事实。我也不清楚自己是怎么被好友连哄带骗搞成一个女装主播的，这事儿我真的不想再提了，那些做作卖萌的动作和表情都是我死也不想回看的脑残过去，总的来说只能用“一失足成千古恨”来描述。而且我被平臺要求主动去联络在直播时打赏比较大方的观众。结果就是我的微信上收到各种不堪入目的下体照、黄图、淫秽视频、油腻语音，以及源源不断的视频邀请。我寻思着这些黄色图片和小视频要是全保存到手机里，哪天被警察叔叔发现了，都够治我一个传播淫秽物品罪。受不了了，我直接撕了合同赔了违约金，跟那个推我入坑的朋友翻了脸，再也没上那个满是油腻老男人和猥琐肥宅的主播微信号。哦，我那朋友还算有良心，在看到我那个主播微信里的聊天记录以后他差点没给我磕头，说没想到现在这个社会这么乱，这些男人全都被叽霸主宰了意识，居然对着一个清纯日系主播发这些东西，真是瞎了心了。我想，如果那些人知道我是个女装大佬以后还坚持给我发这些，那才是真的瞎了心了。他还关切地问我有没有心理阴影，怕我以后恐男。这个问题很有趣了，我自己就是个男的，我还是个gay，我要是恐男了，以后还怎么活。况且，这些事情跟三年前那场噩梦一样的经历比起来，屁都不算。骆非跟我说，他有个朋友想见我。骆非是我一朋友，性取向不是很明朗的样子，一会儿男朋友一会儿女朋友的，浪得不行。我想想骆非的朋友能是什么好东西？反正我就不是什么好东西，况且骆非的舅舅还是道上的，骆非从小在黑社会的教导下长大，我都怀疑他的朋友会不会是哪个在逃杀人犯。我说不见，最近忙着开咖啡厅，没空。骆非死皮赖脸，说他那朋友偶然看见过我的直播视频，据说非常垂涎我。我抖了抖烟灰，问骆非：“他知道我是男的吗？”骆非笑着喝了口酒：“当然知道了，本来见你穿女装他还没什么兴趣，我一说你是个男生，他立刻就来劲了。”我：“呵呵，死gay。”骆非：“骂谁呢！”我：“你这么激动干嘛？”骆非：“我脱双成gay了。”我：“恭喜啊，哪家的小男生让你固定性取向了？”骆非：“这个以后再说，你先说见不见吧？愿意的话我今晚就约个局。”我：“不见。”

咖啡厅刚开业不久，虽然员工都齐活儿了，能力也都不错，但是作为老板，我还是日常要去走个过场以示我对这份事业的关心。我今天睡到下午三点半，一醒来就想着往咖啡厅赶，我可真敬业，年底勤奋员工奖我非得给自己争个名额不可。下了车，在咖啡厅门口看到一人。一身西装，外面套着一件棉服外套，身量挺拔修长，正站在路边的树下隔着人行道看着我的店，手里拿着一支烟。冬天，夕阳来得早，金黄一片地洒过来，树叶簌簌作响，那人的侧影笼在昏黄的光线和烟雾里，像幅漂亮的画。说到画，对了对了，有灵感了，可以在店里挂上几幅，以卖弄一下小资情调。我自诩审美在线，也承认是外貌协会，上我床的每个炮友的身材长相都在我的品位里，而不远处那个站在树下抽着烟的男人，老实说，着实符合我的口味。符合也没用，好看的人多了去了，我不缺炮友，也不干主动搭讪的事。我面无表情地往店里走，走到门口时余光瞥见那个男人抬起了头，一个没忍住，我转头跟他对视了一眼。确实好看，线条光滑流畅的脸，高挺的鼻梁，深度恰好的眉眼，光看气质似乎有些凌厉，但眼角眉梢却挂着几分散漫，望过来时的目光赤裸裸不加掩饰，其中的兴趣意味昭然若揭，仿佛就是为了等我看他一眼。一眼就够了，心里已经有数了，估计是哪个有钱的浪荡富二代，看谁都是一副捕猎心态，带着胜券在握的从容和轻佻。事实证明确实是这样的。“梁暖？”他开口，随手掐灭了烟扔进垃圾桶。声音很好听，清澈明朗，让人愿意听他多说几句。我松了握在门把上的手，侧身给正从店里出来的客人让出了一个位置，然后看着他，问：“你哪位？”“骆非朋友。”他说着，往我这边走过来，目光一直落在我的脸上：“他跟你说起过吗？有人想见见你。”我“哦”了一声：“见到了，可以走了吧？”“留个微信吧。”他说，“看你挺忙的，今天就不打扰了。”我有点不解，既然他跟骆非认识，明明可以从骆非那里要我的微信，何必当着面问。不知道是我脸上的表情太明显，还是眼前的这个人心思通透，他看着我的眼睛，淡淡地笑着：“总觉得当面来要微信比较好，这样你起码知道了我的样子，不会在聊天的时候想不出来一张具体的脸，最少也能有个印象。”这套说辞，拿去骗骗初涉情场的清纯小朋友还有用，在我这里，只会让我更加笃定他是个靠嘴哄人的老手而已。“没带手机。”我找了个最不着调的谎，“我也不爱聊微信，更不和不熟的人瞎聊。”他倒是也没说什么让我输微信号或者留手机号的话，只是把双手插在棉服外套里，抬起头朝我笑了笑：“好，那下次再说。”我站得比他高一个臺阶，这样俯视下去，总觉得他仰头笑时带着些纯澈天真的意味，很像记忆里一个我不愿再回忆起来的人。我朝他挥挥手，开门进店，迎宾铃清脆地响起，门缓缓关上，我回过头时，看见他还站在原地，脸被玻璃门上面漆着的字体挡住一些，只露出嘴巴和下巴。是在笑，而且笑意是真切的愉悦，丝毫不为我的态度有任何的气馁和挫败。
content_en:
I often woke up from that nightmare, and when I opened my eyes, I found that it was not a nightmare, but a fact that had happened.A fact so cruel that it could ruin my life.I don’t know how I was coaxed and tricked by my friends into becoming a cross-dressing anchor. I really don’t want to mention it anymore. Those pretentious and cute actions and expressions are all my stupid past that I don’t want to look back on. Generally speaking, I can only describe it as “one mistake will lead to eternal hatred”.Moreover, I was asked by the platform to take the initiative to contact viewers who were generous in giving rewards during the live broadcast.As a result, I received all kinds of unsightly private photos, pornographic pictures, obscene videos, greasy voices, and a steady stream of video invitations on my WeChat account.I thought that if all these pornographic pictures and short videos were saved on my mobile phone, and the police officers discovered them one day, they would be enough to charge me with distributing obscene materials.I couldn't stand it anymore, so I tore up the contract and paid the liquidated damages, fell out with the friend who pushed me into the trap, and never joined the anchor's WeChat account full of greasy old men and filthy fat nerds.Oh, my friend is quite conscientious. After seeing the chat history of my anchor on WeChat, he almost kowtowed to me. He said that he didn’t expect that society is so chaotic now and that these men are all dominated by Jiba. He actually posted these things to an innocent Japanese anchor. It was really blind.I think if those people still insist on sending me these things after knowing that I am a big shot in women’s clothing, then they are really being blind.He also asked me with concern if I had any psychological shadow, fearing that I would be afraid of men in the future.This question is very interesting. I am a man myself, and I am still gay. If I am afraid of men, how will I survive in the future?Besides, these things are nothing compared to the nightmare experience three years ago.Luo Fei told me that he had a friend who wanted to meet me.Luo Fei is a friend of mine. His sexual orientation is not very clear. He is sometimes my boyfriend and sometimes his girlfriend. He is very flirtatious.I wonder what kind of good friend Luo Fei can be?Anyway, I'm not a good person, and Luo Fei's uncle is still a Taoist. Luo Fei grew up under the guidance of the underworld. I even doubt whether his friend is a fugitive murderer.I said no, I'm busy opening a coffee shop recently, so I don't have time.Luo Fei shamelessly said that his friend had seen my live video by chance and was said to covet me very much.I shook out the cigarette ashes and asked Luo Fei: "Does he know I'm a boy?" Luo Fei smiled and took a sip of wine: "Of course he does. He wasn't interested in seeing you in women's clothes at first, but as soon as I said you were a boy, he immediately became interested." Me: "Haha, you're so gay." Luo Fei: "Who are you scolding?!" Me: "Why are you so excited?" Luo Fei: "I'm gay." Me: "Congratulations, which boy has fixed your sexual orientation?" Luo Fei: "Let's talk about it later.I'll make a date tonight if you want."

The coffee shop has just opened, and although the employees are all fully engaged and capable, as the boss, I still have to go through the motions every day to show my concern for this business.I slept until 3:30 in the afternoon today, and as soon as I woke up, I wanted to rush to the coffee shop. I am so dedicated, and I had to fight for a spot for myself in the Diligent Employee Award at the end of the year.After getting out of the car, I saw a person at the door of the coffee shop.Wearing a suit with a cotton jacket on top, he was tall and slender. He was standing under a tree on the roadside looking at my store from across the sidewalk, holding a cigarette in his hand.In winter, the sunset comes early, shining golden yellow, the leaves are rustling, and the man's profile is enveloped in the dim light and smoke, like a beautiful painting.Speaking of paintings, yes, if you have inspiration, you can hang a few in the store to show off your petty bourgeois sentiment.I pride myself on being an online aesthetician, and I also admit that I belong to the Appearance Association. The body and appearance of every sex friend who sleeps with me are in my taste. To be honest, the man standing under a tree smoking a cigarette not far away is really in line with my taste.It’s no use matching, there are so many good-looking people, I have no shortage of sex partners, and I don’t do anything to strike up conversations.I walked into the store expressionlessly. When I reached the door, I caught a glimpse of the man raising his head. I couldn't help myself, so I turned around and looked at him.He is indeed good-looking, with a face with smooth and smooth lines, a high bridge of nose, and eyebrows with just the right depth. His temperament seems a bit fierce, but his eyes and brows are hanging a little loosely. When he looks over, his eyes are naked and undisguised, and the interest in them is obvious, as if he is just waiting for me to take a look at him.One glance was enough, and I already knew in my heart that he was probably a rich second-generation prodigal who seemed to have a hunting mentality, calm and frivolous as if he had a chance to win.It turns out that is indeed the case."Liang Nuan?" He asked, extinguishing the cigarette and throwing it into the trash can.The voice is nice, clear and clear, making people want to listen to him speak more.I let go of my hand on the doorknob, turned sideways to make room for the customer who was coming out of the store, then looked at him and asked, "Who are you?" "Friend Luo Fei." He said, walking over to me, his eyes always on my face: "Has he told you about it? Someone wants to meet him.See you." I said, "Yes, can you go?" "Leave me a WeChat message." He said, "I see you are very busy, so I won't bother you today." I was a little confused. Since he knew Luo Fei, he could ask for my WeChat message in person.I don’t know if it was the expression on my face that was too obvious or the person in front of me who was very thoughtful. He looked into my eyes and smiled faintly: “I always think it’s better to ask for WeChat in person, so that at least you know what I look like and won’t be unable to think of a specific face during the chat. At least you can have an impression.” This rhetoric is still useful for deceiving innocent children who are new to love. In my case, it only made me more convinced that he is a veteran who relies on his words to coax people."I didn't bring my mobile phone." I found the most blatant lie, "I don't like chatting on WeChat, and I don't talk nonsense with people I don't know well." He didn't say anything to ask me to enter my WeChat ID or leave my mobile phone number. He just put his hands in his cotton-padded jacket.He raised his head and smiled at me: "Okay, let's talk about it next time." I stood a step higher than him. Looking down like this, I always felt that there was something pure and innocent in his smile when he raised his head, much like a person in my memory that I don't want to recall anymore.I waved to him, opened the door and entered the store. The welcome bell rang loudly, and the door slowly closed. When I turned around, I saw that he was still standing there, his face partially obscured by the letters painted on the glass door, with only his mouth and chin exposed.He was smiling, and his smile was truly joyful, not at all discouraged or frustrated by my attitude.
